steps.title: See where a chat points and clicks
steps.body: When a chat uses the mouse in a drawer tab, its cursor appears over the page: it glides to the spot, ripples when it clicks and shows a ring while it holds a button down, then fades away. Its clicks are real mouse input now, so they reach into embedded pages such as a CodePen preview or a payment form, and a chat can drag, double-click and right-click.

keys.text: the cursor moves to where the chat is about to click
a button is held down: a drag is under way
